newsitem.title: CHINA: German firm to seek China site for aluminium plant.
newsitem.headline: German firm to seek China site for aluminium plant.

text.p: German aluminium maker Metall Kontor Kurth K.G. is seeking a Chinese parnter for a joint venture to produce aluminium in China using German facilities, company president Dieter Kurth said in Beijing on Tuesday.
The company wanted to move a secondary aluminium plant currently sited near Dusseldorf to China, he said.
He said the company had yet to find a partner but hoped to complete the move in the next 1-1/2 years.
"The new plant must be sited near a harbour. We are looking for a joint venture partnership," Kurth told Reuters.
Metall Kontor Kurth is also intersted in exporting aluminium granules for steel production, he said, adding that the huge Chinese steel sector made it an attractive market.
